sections.note: New York falls: aerial over the burning district; a tower fails; black title card
The Director pulls himself out of the rubble, stands on the ridge; the army below; the radio in the van
The Crew joins him one by one; equipment readied; the shared turn; the charge
First breach: clash at the crater rim; four decisive contacts break a gap; position gained
Ingenuity: smoke + light decoy; flank attack; tether crash at the girder; catch; drone shields; counter
Strongest attack fells a heavy; the system adapts: high drone, formation change, decoy ignored, flank denied, drone lost, second heavy
Losing ground; last counterattack on the B♭; the ring closes; the Director takes the blow and falls by the van
The machines stop; his last breath; eyes close; stillness
A hand turns the radio on; trumpet; one rising pullback from his face to the fallen city; the vocal enters
Credits crawl: the 2042 scenario text, title, accurate credits
